regime_context: A stagflationary split has sharpened the regime: hot May PCE collides with a weak June payrolls print while the Iran ceasefire collapse re-ignites the oil bid. Warsh's revealed preference is inflation-mandate-first, holding the hawkish line, while the administration engineers low real yields structurally and keeps easing as inflation-gated optionality. Consensus still reads the 'strong dollar while cutting' frame as contradiction; revealed interest says it is the FX bridge that lets the front end ease without breaking FY2026 refi math.
regime_context_zh: 滞胀分化正在加剧：5月PCE偏热与6月非农走弱相撞，而伊朗停火破裂重新点燃油价买盘。沃什的显示性偏好是通胀使命优先、维持鹰派立场；政府则在结构上压低实际收益率，并将宽松作为受通胀约束的选举后期权。市场共识仍把“强美元+降息”框架视为矛盾；显示性利益则表明，这正是让前端利率得以放松、又不破坏2026财年再融资盘算的外汇桥梁。

theses.subject: XOP
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse is a realized upside oil shock, and energy was already the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026. XOP (upstream E&P) is the highest-beta proxy to the re-primed oil bid, with the administration's strategic alignment favoring higher energy prices as cover for the dollar-bridge narrative.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂是已经兑现的油价上冲冲击，而能源本就是2026年一季度ETF流入最多的板块。XOP（上游勘探开采）是对重新点燃的油价买盘β最高的代理标的，且政府战略上乐见能源价格走高，为强美元桥接叙事提供掩护。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire collapsed 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Theater note: 'Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years)'
Rotation map: 'Energy (oil & gas) — proxies XLE, XOP — FACT mechanism (headline-fragile)'
Track record: prior XLE overweight realized +0.1012 (hit)
theses.dissent: Headline-fragile by design: any rapid de-escalation or renewed truce talks could reverse the oil spike as fast as it arrived, and a strong-dollar regime pressures commodity prices in USD terms.
theses.dissent_zh: 该主题本质上是头条脆弱的：任何快速降温或停火谈判重启都可能让油价涨幅以同样的速度回吐，而强美元环境也会压制以美元计价的商品价格。

falsifier.text: XOP lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date while Brent fails to hold above $75
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日前XOP落后SPY达5%以上，同时布伦特未能守住75美元上方

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh holds the hawkish line with CME FedWatch now pricing >70% probability of a September hike. Near-term real yields face upward pressure from the inflation-mandate-first posture, and the labor-crack leg has not yet widened enough to force a data-driven pivot. Long-duration Treasuries are the direct casualty.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什维持鹰派立场，CME FedWatch目前对9月加息的定价概率超过70%。通胀使命优先的姿态使近期实际收益率面临上行压力，而就业走弱尚未扩大到足以迫使其转向数据驱动的宽松。长久期美债是直接受损方。
evidence: Market state: 'CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)'
Thesis UPDATE 7/6: 'Warsh's Sintra response (7/1) held the hawkish line'
Open prediction: 'The Fed does NOT cut at the July and September 2026 meetings (hold or hike)'
Track record: prior TLT underweight realized -0.0719 (hit)
theses.dissent: The weak June payrolls (+57k vs ~115k expected) is precisely the labor-crack catalyst the spine flagged as the one thing that can reopen an easing path; if the July jobs print cracks harder, a September pivot reprices duration violently.
theses.dissent_zh: 6月非农走弱（+57k vs 预期约115k）正是催化剂主轴标明的、唯一能重新打开宽松路径的就业裂口信号；若7月就业数据进一步恶化，9月转向将剧烈重估长久期资产。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 4% or more before the check-by date as market pricing shifts to a September cut
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日前TLT跑赢SPY达4%以上，同时市场定价转向9月降息

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff regime and Section 301 replacement handoff keep the onshoring premium alive for domestic semiconductor capacity. The SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind the tariff-protection bid, and the strategic re-industrialization mandate steers capital toward fabs regardless of the China trade truce status.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税机制与301条款替代方案的交接，使国内半导体的在岸化溢价得以延续。最高法院的否决并未解除关税保护带来的买盘，而战略再工业化使命无论中美贸易休战状态如何，都会将资本引向晶圆厂。
evidence: China theater: 'The SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind the tariff-protection premium'
China theater: 'onshoring bid persists contingent on the Section 301 handoff completing cleanly'
Open prediction: 'The 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force (not rescinded) and/or the covered list expands'
Track record: prior SMH overweight realized +0.0138 (hit)
theses.dissent: The Section 122 expiry on July 24 and pending Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) is a transition risk — if the handoff fails or the effective tariff rate drops materially, the protection premium unwinds and SMH gives back its onshoring bid.
theses.dissent_zh: 7月24日到期的Section 122与待定的Section 301替代方案（约12.5%）构成过渡风险——若交接失败或有效关税率大幅下降，保护溢价将解除，SMH会回吐其在岸化买盘。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date as China effective tariff rate falls below 10%
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日前SMH落后SPY达5%以上，同时中国综合有效关税率降至10%以下

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Gold is range-bound at $4,044-4,200 with the dollar off its 13-month high but holding above 100.9. A September hike is now the majority market pricing, which raises real yields and the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold — a headwind that caps the metal near-term despite the geopolitical bid.
theses.thesis_zh: 金价在4,044至4,200区间震荡，美元虽从13个月高点回落但仍守住100.9上方。9月加息已成为市场主流定价，这会推高实际收益率并抬高持有无息黄金的机会成本——尽管有地缘政治买盘，这一逆风仍会在短期内压制金价上行空间。
evidence: Market state: 'gold trading $4,044–4,200 range' and 'DXY ~100.9 well off its 13-mo high'
Market state: 'CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike'
Thesis: 'real 10y 2.29%, gold<$4,000' during staging phase — hawkish credibility banking
Track record: two prior GLD underweight calls both realized as hits (+0.0163, +0.0262)
theses.dissent: If the Mar-a-Lago theory tail gains traction or the labor crack forces a dovish repricing, gold becomes the cleanest hedge against a dollar-down / real-yield-down regime — and the Iran haven bid is already live.
theses.dissent_zh: 若Mar-a-Lago理论尾部风险升温，或就业裂口迫使市场重新定价为鸽派，黄金将成为美元走弱/实际收益率下行环境中最为纯粹的避险对冲——而伊朗避险买盘目前已经活跃。

falsifier.text: GLD outperforms SPY by 4% or more before the check-by date as September hike probability falls below 50%
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日前GLD跑赢SPY达4%以上，同时9月加息概率降至50%以下

theses.subject: XAR
theses.thesis: Defense remains a structural spending super-cycle decoupled from the ceasefire cycle: NATO budget commitments, missile-defense/Golden Dome, munitions and drone programs all persist regardless of whether the Iran conflict cools or re-escalates. XAR (defense & aerospace, equal-weight, broader than ITA's primes) captures the rotation with less single-name concentration.
theses.thesis_zh: 国防仍是一个与停火周期脱钩的结构性支出超级周期：北约预算承诺、导弹防御/金穹项目、弹药与无人机计划无论伊朗冲突降温还是升级都将继续推进。XAR（国防与航空航天，等权，比ITA的龙头股更分散）以更低的个股集中度捕捉这一轮动。
evidence: NATO / Defense theater: 'structural spending super-cycle' — 'defense primes + shipbuilding + missile-defense/Golden Dome + munitions + drones'
Theater note: 'Defense bid persists regardless' of ceasefire status
Rotation map: FACT mechanism proxies include XAR
Track record caution: prior ITA overweight missed (-0.1041, -0.108) — XAR's equal-weight profile may diversify stock-specific risk
theses.dissent: Prior ITA defense calls have missed twice, suggesting the defense bid is either fully priced or the ETF-level beta is not capturing the super-cycle thesis; a de-escalation headline cycle could also trigger profit-taking across the defense complex.
theses.dissent_zh: 此前的ITA国防看多已两次落空，表明国防买盘要么已经充分定价，要么ETF层面的β未能捕捉到超级周期主题；而降级头条周期也可能在整个国防板块触发获利了结。

falsifier.text: XAR lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date as NATO spending headlines fail to catalyze defense flows
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日前XAR落后SPY达5%以上，同时北约开支新闻未能催化国防板块资金流入
